caption: The drawing is on a rectangular sheet with a light beige background. Across the top, there is a decorative border consisting of a repeating pattern of red, leafy swags accented with small green elements. Below this border, there are two large, centrally placed motifs resembling pinecones or clusters of small red ovals, each resting on a green base and flanked by small green leaves. In the lower area of the drawing, there are three birds, each colored in shades of red and perched on thin green stems or plant-like forms. Between the birds and the pinecone motifs, there are additional green leafy shapes and small groups of red marks scattered irregularly. Along the bottom edge, a horizontal row of green leaves forms another border. The overall composition is symmetrical, with the same motifs mirrored on either side of the central vertical axis. The drawing is outlined and filled in simple, muted red and green tones, with all objects spaced on a visually even background.
title: Wall Stencil
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
